cases.prompt: What is the company's policy on remote work eligibility?
cases.context: Employee Handbook, Section 4.2: Employees who have completed their six-month probation period are eligible to work remotely up to three days per week, subject to manager approval. Roles requiring on-site lab access are excluded.
rubric: Faithfulness: every claim is supported by the context with no fabrication
Completeness: states the three-days-per-week limit and the probation requirement
Groundedness: notes the manager-approval and lab-access exclusion
cases.referenceAnswer: Employees who have completed their six-month probation period may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Roles requiring on-site lab access are excluded.

cases.prompt: How many vacation days do new employees receive in their first year?
cases.context: Benefits Guide: New full-time employees accrue 1.25 vacation days per month worked during their first calendar year, up to a maximum of 15 days. Unused days may carry over up to 5 days into the next year.
rubric: Faithfulness: uses only the accrual figures from the context
cases.referenceAnswer: New full-time employees accrue 1.25 vacation days per month, up to 15 days in the first year, with up to 5 unused days carried over to the next year.

cases.prompt: What is the data retention period for customer support tickets?
cases.context: Data Governance Policy 7.1: Customer support tickets and their attachments are retained for 24 months from the date of closure, after which they are permanently deleted unless subject to a legal hold.
rubric: Faithfulness: states 24 months without inventing other periods
Completeness: ties retention to the date of closure
cases.referenceAnswer: Customer support tickets are retained for 24 months from closure, then permanently deleted unless under a legal hold.
